# Indirect Competitors

**The real competition.** In Indian institutions the incumbent is almost always free, and it is almost always something nobody chose.

| Alternative | Real price | Threat |
|---|---|---|
| **Excel / Google Sheets** | ₹0 – ~₹2,000/yr (bundled in licences already paid) | CRITICAL |
| **WhatsApp + Google Drive** | ₹0 | CRITICAL |
| **Notion / Superhuman Docs** | ~$126k–₹1.73L/yr at IIC scale | HIGH |
| **Airtable** | ₹0 – paid per seat | HIGH |
| **CRM (Zoho / Freshworks / Freshsales)** | ₹800–₹6,399 per user/month | HIGH |
| **Project management (Trello / ClickUp / Monday / Asana)** | ₹154k–₹1.19L/yr at 10 users | MEDIUM |
| **Campus ERP (Fedena, EduZenAI, Campusify)** | ₹10,000–₹7.2L/yr; per-student variants | HIGH |
| **Email + Word/Excel** | ₹0 | MEDIUM |

## In detail

### Excel / Google Sheets

- **Real price.** ₹0 – ~₹2,000/yr (bundled in licences already paid)
- **Why it wins.** Free, universal, no procurement. Every institution already has it.
- **What it cannot do.** No permissions, no audit trail, no relational integrity, no workflow, manual consolidation across departments.
- **Evidence.** PHASE 4 corpus - the IIC annual report is hand-assembled from spreadsheets (P-A08)
- **Threat.** CRITICAL

### WhatsApp + Google Drive

- **Real price.** ₹0
- **Why it wins.** It is the operational database. IISc's own IIC page links students to a WhatsApp group.
- **What it cannot do.** No structure, no permissions, no audit trail, no reporting.
- **Evidence.** COMP-024; GAP-10
- **Threat.** CRITICAL

### Notion / Superhuman Docs

- **Real price.** ~$126k–₹1.73L/yr at IIC scale
- **Why it wins.** Flexible, cheap at small team size, attractive UI that staff already want to use.
- **What it cannot do.** Audit logs gated behind Enterprise; no retroactive history; no offline; no Indian compliance.
- **Evidence.** _exports/csv/pricing_ledger.csv
- **Threat.** HIGH

### Airtable

- **Real price.** ₹0 – paid per seat
- **Why it wins.** The default 'build it ourselves' database. RiserNest and VentureLink both position against it by name.
- **What it cannot do.** No institutional domain model; audit history limited; Indian data residency uncertain.
- **Evidence.** RiserNest and VentureLink positioning copy
- **Threat.** HIGH

### CRM (Zoho / Freshworks / Freshsales)

- **Real price.** ₹800–₹6,399 per user/month
- **Why it wins.** Cheap, ubiquitous, and the incumbent IIC coordinators already know.
- **What it cannot do.** Models PIPELINE, not incubation. No TRL, no IPR, no scheme mapping. Per-user pricing collapses institutional ACV (Phase 8).
- **Evidence.** Phase 8 comparables
- **Threat.** HIGH

### Project management (Trello / ClickUp / Monday / Asana)

- **Real price.** ₹154k–₹1.19L/yr at 10 users
- **Why it wins.** Task tracking is the visible symptom; teams adopt it before anything else.
- **What it cannot do.** No domain model, no intake workflow, no IPR. Audit logs enterprise-only.
- **Evidence.** _exports/csv/pricing_ledger.csv
- **Threat.** MEDIUM

### Campus ERP (Fedena, EduZenAI, Campusify)

- **Real price.** ₹10,000–₹7.2L/yr; per-student variants
- **Why it wins.** The institution already owns one and pays for it regardless. Fedena sells a broader product for ₹1,00,000 flat.
- **What it cannot do.** **Zero Indian campus ERP vendors have a startup-incubation module.** They stop at admissions, fees and exams.
- **Evidence.** Phase 8 comparables; Phase 9 campus ERP row
- **Threat.** HIGH

### Email + Word/Excel

- **Real price.** ₹0
- **Why it wins.** Always works, always available, needs no committee.
- **What it cannot do.** No calculation, no lineage, binary re-entry, month-end blackout.
- **Evidence.** Phase 1 corpus
- **Threat.** MEDIUM

## Why this category is the real one

Phase 8 priced a full Indian campus ERP at ₹1,00,000 flat, and found free substitutes offered by Univation, Founderhood and Notion. The pricing question and the competitive question are the same question: **a buyer with a free option and a ₹1 lakh incumbent has no reason to pay a new entrant at ₹1.2 lakh unless the entrant is the only thing that produces the compliance artefact.**

That is the same conclusion GAP-03 reaches from the other direction.
